name: Disaster Damage Assessment Dataset
description: A dataset for assessing disaster damage (e.g., building damage) from imagery to support training and evaluation of automated damage assessment methods.
reputation: Used in disaster-response and remote-sensing research for building-damage assessment; moderately cited in domain literature but not as ubiquitous as some large-scale remote sensing benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; possible geographic/scene bias and limited dataset size in some splits; annotations can be subjective; users should check for dataset currency and overlap with other benchmarks.
